selection-mode.description:
Whether the tree supports multiple selection
- "single": only one node can be selected
- "multiple": multiple nodes can be selected

default-expanded-value.description:
The initial expanded node ids when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the expanded node value.

default-selected-value.description:
The initial selected node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the selected node value.

default-checked-value.description:
The initial checked node value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the checked node value.

can-rename.description: Function to determine if a node can be renamed

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

expandedchange.description: Called when the tree is opened or closed

focuschange.description: Called when the focused node changes

checkedchange.description: Called when the checked value changes

renamestart.description: Called when a node starts being renamed

renamecomplete.description: Called when a node label rename is completed

loadchildrencomplete.description: Called when a node finishes loading children

loadchildrenerror.description: Called when loading children fails for one or more nodes

canRename.description: Function to determine if a node can be renamed

onBeforeRename.description: Called before a rename is completed. Return false to prevent the rename.

loadChildren.description:
Function to load children for a node asynchronously.
When provided, branches will wait for this promise to resolve before expanding.

scrollToIndexFn.description:
Function to scroll to a specific index.
Useful for virtualized tree views.

ids.description: The ids of the tree elements. Useful for composition.

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

collection.description: The nodes to show, e.g. from `createTreeCollection`. Assign a new collection to update the tree.

ready.description: Resolves once the element's machine has started, so `api`, state and parts are in place.

api.description: The Zag API of the component. `undefined` until it connects.

expand.description:
Function to expand nodes.
If no value is provided, all nodes will be expanded

collapse.description:
Function to collapse nodes
If no value is provided, all nodes will be collapsed

for.description: The id of the root this part belongs to, when it is not a descendant.

state.description: The part's state from its machine, such as an item's `selected` and `highlighted`. `undefined` until it connects.
